setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays one trig on step 1: root C (MIDI 60, C3) at velocity 127, with Chd1 to Chd4 set to 64, 67, 69 and 72; the output is polyphonic. Trig params is open on its parameter list, showing Chord Note Strum. Nothing is assigned yet. This is a slow comparison at 90 BPM and Rate /9: each channel step lasts 1.5 seconds. The long note lets all five voices finish before Stop.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Chord Note Strum to the first slot and K2 to return, then turn E3 up to 1/2: the notes will be half a step apart. Turn E2 to the next slot, press K2 and turn E3 to Chord Spread.
steps.title: Set a half-step Strum

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Chord Spread and K2 to return, then turn E3 up to 1/4. Chord Accel Mod is not assigned, so every gap stays the same. Each gap is now 3/4 step (1/2 + 1/4) instead of 1/2. Tap Play (1,8), then tap it again to stop. The MIDI strip lists the root C3 (60) and then E3 (64), G3 (67), A3 (69), C4 (72), evenly spaced 3/4 step apart. Here 3/4 of a channel step is 1.125 seconds, so the five onsets are evenly separated; every voice retains velocity 127.

steps.title: Widen each gap for a slow, harp-like roll
